name: generate_3_level_categorization
description: Generate a structured 3-level categorization hierarchy for a procurement item

level_1_category.description: Top-level category (broad industry/functional area). Examples: Office Equipment, Safety & Security, Construction Materials, Industrial Equipment, Electronics & Technology

level_2_category.description: Mid-level category (specific functional group). Examples: Digital Devices, Personal Protection, Building Materials, Power Systems, Communication Equipment

level_3_category.description: Specific category (precise item type). Examples: Laptops & Accessories, Safety Helmets, Concrete & Cement, Generators & UPS, Network Equipment

confidence_score.description: Confidence score between 0 and 1 for this categorization

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this 3-level categorization was chosen, considering the item description and similar items context
